summary: Enhance your managerial skills with our Data-Driven Decision Making training course. Learn to leverage data for effective strategies and improved outcomes.
lede: Data-Driven Decision Making for Managers helps you turn scattered information into a structured approach for evaluating performance and choosing action. You will learn to identify useful data sources, define meaningful KPIs, interpret trends objectively, and apply analytics throughout daily management decisions. Through practical exercises, you will design KPI dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders, and create decision-support frameworks and action plans. The course also introduces predictive modeling at an overview level while addressing practical constraints such as budget limits, data privacy requirements, and technology adoption gaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for managers and leaders who must make high-stakes decisions in complex, data-rich environments. prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of Excel (basic formulas, charts); no coding or advanced statistics required. Participants should have access to organizational data sources (e.g., reports, logs) and a laptop for hands-on exercises. Tools: Excel, Tableau, or Power BI (free versions or organizational licenses).
